# Command reference

Every `dfm` command, from its own `--help`.

## dfm

```text
Usage: dfm [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Developer Foundation Model: local, privacy-first engineering agent.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --version               Show the version and exit.                                               │
│ --offline               No network at all, for any purpose.                                      │
│ --local-models          No remote model inference; engineering networking follows policy         │
│                         (default).                                                               │
│ --help                  Show this message and exit.                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ doctor           Check this machine: models, integrations, tools, policy. Read-only and offline. │
│ diff             Show what changed against a base ref (read-only).                               │
│ ask              Answer a question about the repository from RepoCanon + RepoKG facts (no        │
│                  edits).                                                                         │
│ plan             Plan a change without editing anything (tests run in a read-only sandbox).      │
│ implement        Make the change, run the checks, and report only what was verified.             │
│ resume           Continue an interrupted session after checking what changed since.              │
│ review           Review a diff: deterministic checks, structure, and verified model findings.    │
│ security-review  Security review of a diff: checklists, removed auth checks, dependency changes, │
│                  ops surface, and verified model findings. Exit 1 on HIGH or BLOCKER findings.   │
│ issue            Show a GitHub issue (live, or from the cache when GitHub is unavailable).       │
│ implement-issue  Implement a GitHub issue in the working tree; works offline from the cache.     │
│ pr               Show a pull request with its files and check results.                           │
│ review-pr        Review a pull request's diff (PR head checked out in a DFM worktree when        │
│                  possible).                                                                      │
│ fix-pr           Triage review comments, fix the valid ones in a worktree (a patch), draft       │
│                  replies.                                                                        │
│ comments         List a pull request's inline review comments.                                   │
│ ci               Find the failing CI step, reproduce it locally, and fix it only if it fails     │
│                  here too.                                                                       │
│ services         List known, running and DFM-owned local services (Postgres, Redis, devnets,     │
│                  ...).                                                                           │
│ inspect-log      Head, tail, grep, field filters, time windows, sampling, error clusters and     │
│                  stack                                                                           │
│                  groups, in one streaming pass with bounded memory. Every printed line is        │
│                  redacted.                                                                       │
│ status           Recent DFM sessions for this repository, their metrics, and what DFM still      │
│                  runs.                                                                           │
│ profile          Latency per stage, tokens, context size, tool calls, repairs and memory for a   │
│                  session.                                                                        │
│ benchmark        Run every task in a fresh copy, offline, under each ablation; write JSON + a    │
│                  markdown table.                                                                 │
│ setup            Prepare this machine for DFM: models, integrations, config, offline checks.     │
│ config           Show the effective configuration and its file locations.                        │
│ processes        List and stop processes DFM started (never anyone else's).                      │
│ sessions         List DFM sessions for this repository.                                          │
│ repo             Repository intelligence: RepoCanon facts and the RepoKG graph.                  │
│ models           Local MLX coding models: what is here, what fits, which DFM uses.               │
│ memory           Reflex practices and skills relevant to this repository (read-only).            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

## dfm ask

```text
Usage: dfm ask [OPTIONS] {question}

 Answer a question about the repository from RepoCanon + RepoKG facts (no edits).

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    question      <str>  A question about this repository. [required]                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --repo        <path>  Repository root.                                                           │
│ --json                Machine-readable output.                                                   │
│ --help                Show this message and exit.                                                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

## dfm benchmark

```text
Usage: dfm benchmark [OPTIONS]

 Run every task in a fresh copy, offline, under each ablation; write JSON + a markdown table.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --tasks            <str>    Comma-separated task ids (default: all).                             │
│ --ablation         <str>    Repeatable: coder, +canon, +kg, +reflex, +apple, full.               │
│ --repeat           <int>    Runs per task and ablation. [default: 1]                             │
│ --max-steps        <int>    Coder steps per run. [default: 20]                                   │
│ --reference                 Replay reference solutions (checks the harness, no model).           │
│ --out              <path>   Results directory.                                                   │
│ --model            <path>   Local MLX model directory: the only coder for every step (primary    │
│                             and small).                                                          │
│ --cooldown         <float>  Seconds to pause after each run that used a model (heat).            │
│                             [default: 30.0]                                                      │
│ --list                      List the tasks and exit.                                             │
│ --json                      Print results as JSON.                                               │
│ --help                      Show this message and exit.                                          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

## dfm ci

```text
Usage: dfm ci [OPTIONS]

 Find the failing CI step, reproduce it locally, and fix it only if it fails here too.

 Never re-runs or cancels remote workflows.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --run              <int>   Workflow run id (default: latest failure on this branch).             │
│ --log              <path>  Use this log file (gh run view --log-failed format) instead of        │
│                            GitHub.                                                               │
│ --repo             <path>  Repository root.                                                      │
│ --offline                  Use cached GitHub data only.                                          │
│ --max-steps        <int>   Coder steps before stopping. [default: 25]                            │
│ --json                     Machine-readable output.                                              │
│ --help                     Show this message and exit.                                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

## dfm fix-pr

```text
Usage: dfm fix-pr [OPTIONS] {number}

 Triage review comments, fix the valid ones in a worktree (a patch), draft replies.

 Never pushes; prints the commands for you to apply and push.

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    number      <int>  Issue or pull request number. [required]                                 │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --repo                <path>  Repository root.                                                   │
│ --offline                     Use the local cache only; do not contact GitHub.                   │
│ --max-steps           <int>   Coder steps before stopping. [default: 25]                         │
│ --post-replies                Post the drafted replies (each one asks first).                    │
│ --json                        Machine-readable output.                                           │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                                        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

## dfm inspect-log

```text
Usage: dfm inspect-log [OPTIONS] {file}

 Head, tail, grep, field filters, time windows, sampling, error clusters and stack groups, in one
 streaming pass with bounded memory. Every printed line is redacted.

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    file      <file>  Log or JSONL file (any size). [required]                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --head                               <int>  First N matching lines. [default: 0]                 │
│ --tail                               <int>  Last N (matching) lines. [default: 0]                │
│ --grep                               <str>  Only lines matching this regex.                      │
│ --field,--jq-like                    <str>  JSONL filter FIELD=VALUE (dotted paths); repeatable. │
│ --window                             <str>  Time window START..END (ISO).                        │
│ --sample                             <int>  N random matching lines (reservoir). [default: 0]    │
│ --cluster            --no-cluster           Group errors by template. [default: cluster]         │
│ --stacks             --no-stacks            Group stack traces. [default: stacks]                │
│ --top                                <int>  Clusters and stacks to show. [default: 10]           │
│ --json                                      Machine-readable output.                             │
│ --help                                      Show this message and exit.                          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

```text
│ *    number      <int>  Issue or pull request number. [required]                                 │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --repo           <path>  Repository root.                                                        │
│ --offline                Use the local cache only; do not contact GitHub.                        │
│ --json                   Machine-readable output.                                                │
│ --help                   Show this message and exit.                                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

## dfm security-review

```text
Usage: dfm security-review [OPTIONS]

 Security review of a diff: checklists, removed auth checks, dependency changes, ops surface, and
 verified model findings. Exit 1 on HIGH or BLOCKER findings.

│ --stdin                 Read the diff from stdin instead of running git.                         │
│ --help                  Show this message and exit.                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```
